scope: Existing ASCII paths in the configured guest mounts. Regular files, backup-directory handles and final native symbolic-link handles. Not a Windows token/DACL or reparse-tag implementation.

access.read_attributes: retained bit 8, excluded from share tests
access.write_attributes: retained bit 16, excluded from share tests
access.seek: internal request 128 requires data read or data write

behavior: Missing cacert.pem retains ERROR_FILE_NOT_FOUND; no fixture is added to the game profile.
Share checks are bidirectional by native device/inode; duplicate handles retain reservations.
BACKUP_SEMANTICS admits a directory; it grants no backup privilege.
OPEN_REPARSE_POINT preserves the final name and uses Darwin O_SYMLINK; dangling or outward links can be opened as link objects, while intermediate escapes remain rejected.
Ordinary resolution follows contained links. Content operations retain separate rights and regular-file checks.
Descriptor inheritance and native authority are preserved. Native mutation permission must be checked when any future metadata/delete operation is implemented.
limitations: ASCII and existing paths only; creation/truncation/overlapped/device/template modes remain explicit gates.
No Windows ACL, access-token, backup/restore privilege, arbitrary reparse-tag or delete-by-handle implementation.
Native host changes do not participate in the process-local Windows share registry.
Path-based component resolution inherits the existing namespace resolver race limitations.
